app.title: Video Dubber
steps.label: Steps
tpl.uploadHint: Pick a winning ad (MP4/MOV, up to 1 GB). Do this once per video; next time pick it from the list.
tpl.name: Name
tpl.previewHint: The red box is the old caption area that gets blurred. Click “Preview” to see the new caption at this moment.
tpl.captionsHint: Each row: start second · end second · original text. Caption 1 is the hook, replaced by each text line in step 3.
tpl.voiceHint: Each line: start · end · words. The new voice is placed on these timestamps.
cover.title: Old caption cover
cover.hint: Pixel coordinates of the source video. This area is blurred while captions show.
audio.originalHint: Change text only, keep voice + music
audio.separateHint: Removes the original voice, keeps background music (needs separation model)
audio.music_fileHint: Use a music file you upload
langs.title: Pick languages
langs.hint: Each language can have several hooks — enter them in the next step.
tr.title: Text per language
tr.hint: Each line in “Hooks” = 1 video. E.g. 3 lines × 2 languages = 6 videos.
tr.copied: Prompt copied — paste it into Claude, then paste the reply below.
tr.filled: Translations filled in — review before running.
tr.caption: Caption
tr.syncHook: Voice line 1 reads the hook (text and voice match)
tr.tooLong: “{text}…” is 30% longer than the original — text may shrink
res.title: Results
res.fixHint: Edit the lines for {lang} and click Create videos — untick other languages to re-render only this one.
tpl.needCaption: Add at least one caption with text: click “+ Add caption” and enter start, end and the original on-screen text.
res.log: View log (send to support if the tool errors or hangs)
audio.uploaded_voiceHint: Remove original voice, keep music, use your voice file
audio.voiceFile: Voice file (MP3/WAV/M4A) — shared by all videos
